Theme of the Figures of PhyloCactus

Source: R/palette.R
theme_phylocactus.Rd

The one theme of the package figures, the theme written for the figures of Tutorial 3 and moved into the package as it was: theme_minimal() with a light grey panel and a white grid, italic axis titles, bold legend and strip titles. Its colours come from phylocactus_colours("theme"). The title of a figure is its caption, not a title inside the plot. Trees use ggtree::theme_tree() instead.

Usage

theme_phylocactus(base_size = 12, base_family = "")

Arguments

base_size

Numeric. Base font size in points. Defaults to 12.

base_family

Character. Base font family. Defaults to "".

Value

A ggplot2 theme.

See also

phylocactus_colours().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg)) + ggplot2::geom_point() + theme_phylocactus()
} # }
